text:
ellie: Follow-up from today's scheduler sync — want to discuss compactness calibration and a decayable credit token to avoid hoarding.
peter: Nice. We should consider a predictive compactness signal (simple moving avg + anomaly score) so scheduler only asks for reclaim when fragmentation is predicted to persist.
sam: Agreed. Prediction reduces RPCs. But keep a fallback: shaping + reserve token flow for the corner cases.
nora: Prototype idea: compactness_score in [0..1], plus persist_count (how many windows above threshold). Only escalate if persist_count >= N.
ellie: Example metrics export: ```text
/metrics compactness -> {lane, score:0.72, persist:3, head_gap_ms:42, reserved_count:2}
```
peter: Token semantics: opaque credits_token with fields (amount, expires_at_ms, decay_rate). Batcher issues token on reclaim ack; scheduler redeems. Decay_rate slowly reduces redeemable amount to prevent hoarding.
sam: We need idempotency and lease_version on reclaim calls. Also a cancel endpoint for ownership transfers.
nora: Wire sketch (text): ```text
POST /batcher/shaping -> {lane, lease_token} => {shaped:true, est_freed:3, hold_ms:80}
POST /batcher/reclaim -> {lane, lease_token, target, idempotency_key} => {job_id}
POST /batcher/reclaim/ack -> {job_id} => {credits_token, freed, reserve_ms}
POST /scheduler/credits/redeem -> {credits_token, amount} => {redeemed:true}
POST /batcher/reclaim/cancel -> {job_id, lease_token} => {cancelled:true, freed_partial:int}
```
ellie: Observability: add compactness.{score,persist} and credits.{issued,redeemed,expired,decayed}. Also measure ack->redeem latency.
peter: Rollout plan: 1) expose compactness stream + threshold logic (FF), 2) add shaping endpoint in canary, 3) lab-only reclaim with credits_token and decay, 4) opt-in tenants for reclaim, 5) widen if p99 tails improve.
sam: Perf tests: synthetic churn traces and lane transfer during reclaim. Also test slow redeems (scheduler GC) to validate decay behavior.
nora: Edge case: partial reclaim on crash. Batcher must persist job state and tokens; if partial, ack returns freed<N and token for that amount. Scheduler must accept partial credits.
ellie: Action items: ellie -> write RFC with prediction heuristics and decay math; peter -> token persistence sketch; sam -> perf scenarios; nora -> telemetry dashboards. ops-bot: schedule canary when ready.
ops-bot: deploy-queued: batcher-compactness-v1 -> canary 5% eu-west at 06:00 UTC. Healthchecks 15m :rocket:
